question: Obtain an expression for displacement current between the plates of a parallel plate capacitor in terms of plate area $A$ and rate of change of electric field $\frac{dE}{dt}$.

options.B: For uniform electric field, $\Phi_E=EA$. Thus $\dfrac{d\Phi_E}{dt}=A\dfrac{dE}{dt}$, and $I_D=\varepsilon_0\dfrac{d\Phi_E}{dt}=\varepsilon_0A\dfrac{dE}{dt}$.
